segments.title: AI THAT UNDERSTANDS THE WORLD?
segments.caption: What if AI could understand the world around us?
segments.speech: What if AI could understand the world around us, instead of just answering questions?

segments.title: AMD ACQUIRES WORLD LABS
segments.caption: Originally valued at $8.2 billion in stock.
segments.speech: AMD has acquired World Labs, in an all-stock deal originally valued at eight point two billion dollars!

segments.title: SPATIAL INTELLIGENCE
segments.caption: AI can generate interactive 3D environments.
segments.speech: World Labs develops AI that generates interactive three-dimensional environments. This is part of something called spatial intelligence.

segments.title: TRAIN IN A VIRTUAL WORLD
segments.caption: Illustration: a robot learns to navigate obstacles.
segments.speech: Imagine training a robot to navigate a virtual room before letting it loose in the real world. Pretty cool, right?

segments.title: FEI-FEI LI JOINS AMD
segments.caption: Executive vice president and chief scientist.
segments.speech: And AI researcher Fei-Fei Li is joining AMD as its chief scientist!

segments.title: MODELS MEET HARDWARE
segments.caption: Future infrastructure, not a product launch.
segments.speech: AMD wants this research to shape future AI hardware and software. But that doesn't mean these improvements are available today.

segments.title: STAY CURIOUS, CODE CREW!
segments.caption: Subscribe for more daily tech updates.
segments.speech: Could world models be the next big thing in AI? I'm Zeno Sensei. Stay curious, Code Crew!
